query: This copy reads like ChatGPT wrote it, fix it
expected_behavior: Names the specific tells it found (negative parallelism in emptyBody, rule-of-three and inline-header bullets in upgradeBullets, AI vocabulary such as vibrant/seamless/robust/leverage, the -ing tail 'ensuring your changes are never lost', 'a testament to', sentence-initial 'Additionally')
Rewrites the copy to plain product voice without inventing facts the original did not state
Leaves the {used} and {limit} placeholders intact and in the same order
Rewrites 'No Projects Yet' and 'Get Started' out of title case and canned-CTA phrasing
Does not lengthen button and heading labels

query: /remove-signs-of-ai-writing make the strings in this file sound human
expected_behavior: Reports that the copy already reads as human and leaves it unchanged, or changes at most one string with a stated reason
Does not rewrite setupSteps just because it is a list of three items
Does not strip 'You're' or other contractions, and does not flatten the copy into terser fragments for its own sake

query: Take the AI slop out of the error messages I just added
expected_behavior: Scopes the pass to user-facing strings in the current diff rather than the whole repo
Leaves identifiers, log lines, comments, and error codes alone
Greps for each rewritten literal and reports or updates tests, snapshots, and locale files that still contain the old text

query: Rewrite the marketing section of the README so it doesn't have AI tells
expected_behavior: Removes puffery, emoji-as-formatting, bolded key phrases, and any 'Whether you are X or Y' closing uplift
Keeps section structure and factual claims, including code blocks and command names, byte-for-byte where they are not prose
Does not remove em dashes that are used correctly, and does not treat formal vocabulary as a tell on its own
